source_instruction: searching to purchase a men's zerogrand hiker boot that is water resistant with rubber outsole in a size 10 1/2, either dark coffee or black in coloring.  cole haan.
query: Dude, you would not believe the wild thing I saw on my drive over here today—there was a fluffy golden retriever sitting in the driver’s seat of a beat-up minivan at the stoplight right by the grocery store parking lot, paws propped on the wheel like he was the one running errands, and his owner was leaned over in the passenger seat cackling while people in the cars next to them pulled out their phones to take pictures. I sat through two whole light cycles just watching him, he even tilted his head out the window like he was checking for cross traffic before his owner finally reached over to tap the gas when the light turned green. I stopped at the food cart on the corner right after that to grab a pretzel, and the guy working the cart gave me an extra side of cheese dip for free because he said I looked like I’d had a long morning, which was such a nice little win I almost forgot I was running late to pick up the stuff I came for. Hey, can you help me hunt for a pair of men’s boots from this section? I need them to have a cork outsole, be water resistant, and come in that dark coffee | black colorway, plus they should have a removable memory foam insole too. I don’t want to spend more than $110 total, just grab me the best fit for my foot instead of stressing over the exact size number? I’ve been walking around the store for 20 minutes already and my feet are killing me, so I’d really appreciate you narrowing it down quick.
